text:
# Pre-market brief, Mon 2026-11-02 (~8:20 AM ET)

1. **Relief bounce after worst week in months.** Futures ~6:10 ET: NQ +0.84% to 28,772, ES +0.6% to 7,623, Dow +0.6% ([Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/premarket-movers-estee-lauder-rivian-rise-premarket-check-point-falls-4991151); [Reuters/Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/wall-street-futures-rise-as-ai-stocks-catch-their-breath-midterms-in-focus-4990733)). Friday: SPX −2%, NDX −3.5%; NDX −6.5% in October, worst month since Mar 2025 ([Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/p-500-nasdaq-futures-rise-101832709.html)).
2. **Oil −4% on US-Iran diplomacy hopes**: Brent $108.66, WTI $99.85 at 5 AM ET; XOM −1.2%, CVX ~−1%, VLO −1.5% pre ([Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/p-500-nasdaq-futures-rise-101832709.html); [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/02/stocks-making-the-biggest-moves-premarket-crwd-rivn-mu.html)). Energy longs at risk; airline fuel avoids dropped.
3. **MRVL to buy LITE** in all-stock deal valuing LITE at $115B (close 1H28); MRVL +3%, LITE +2% then halted ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/02/stocks-making-the-biggest-moves-premarket-crwd-rivn-mu.html)).
4. **Movers**: EL +2.4 to +3.5% (FQ1 adj EPS $0.72 vs $0.51, rev $3.72B vs $3.65B, FY outlook raised); CHKP −9.9% (weak Q4 guide); CRWD +3.4% (DB upgrade), PANW +2%; RIVN +3.8% (UBS upgrade); MU/SNDK/WDC ~+2%; VRT +2.5% ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/02/stocks-making-the-biggest-moves-premarket-crwd-rivn-mu.html); [Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/premarket-movers-estee-lauder-rivian-rise-premarket-check-point-falls-4991151)).
5. **Rates/BTC**: 10y 4.914% (−1bp), 2y 4.589% ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/02/us-treasury-yields-bonds.html)); BTC ~$78.2k, slight bounce after Binance hack ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/02/dollar-rangebound-ahead-of-us-midterms-bitcoin-reels-from-crypto-heist.html)).

## Week ahead
- Today: ISM Mfg 10:00, prior 54.5 ([TradingCharts](https://forex.tradingcharts.com/economic_calendar/2026-11-02.html?code=usd)); AAPL, PLTR AMC ([StockTitan](https://www.stocktitan.net/articles/earnings-calendar-week-of-november-2-2026)).
- Tue 11/3: midterms; JOLTS 10:00; AMD, AMGN AMC ([StockTitan](https://www.stocktitan.net/articles/earnings-calendar-week-of-november-2-2026); [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/02/us-treasury-yields-bonds.html)).
- Wed 11/4: ADP; ISM Services 10:00; UBER BMO (confirmed), MCD BMO (expected); QCOM ([Liquid](https://www.liquid.trade/calendar?week=2026-11-02); [TipRanks](https://www.tipranks.com/news/major-earnings-this-week-november-2-6-2026)).
- Thu 11/5: jobless claims, productivity. Fri 11/6: October payrolls 8:30 ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/02/us-treasury-yields-bonds.html)).
- DIS 11/17 BMO ([Disney IR](https://investors.thewaltdisneycompany.com/news/news-details/2026/The-Walt-Disney-Company-Executives-to-Discuss-Fiscal-Full-Year-and-Fourth-Quarter-2026-Financial-Results-via-Webcast/default.aspx)).

## Swing ideas
- **EL** long, low. Non-tech beat-and-raise (the pattern that has beaten SPY two weeks running); gap under 5%. Risk: gap fades in an event-heavy week (midterms, payrolls).
